gate.title: Disclaimer
gate.body: The Bar Council of India does not permit advocates to solicit work or advertise. By clicking “I agree”, you confirm that you are seeking information about Adv. Sumit Ratnesh Pandey of your own accord, and that no advertisement, solicitation or inducement has been made to you. Nothing on this website is legal advice, and visiting it does not create an advocate–client relationship.
hero.name: Sumit Ratnesh Pandey
hero.role: Advocate, Bar Council of Maharashtra & Goa
hero.lead: I practise in Mumbai with a background in both law and economics. I help individuals, families and businesses understand where they stand and what their options are, in plain language.
about.title: Law, read alongside economics
about.p1: I hold an LL.B. from the University of Mumbai and a master’s degree in Economics. That combination shapes how I work: I look at the legal question, and also at the money, interests and practical consequences around it.
about.p2: I was enrolled with the Bar Council of Maharashtra & Goa in August 2026. My training covers the new criminal laws, the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita and the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, along with drafting, pleading and conveyancing, in which I earned an A+.
about.quote: Every matter deserves careful reading, honest advice and clear drafting.
about.langs: I advise in English, Hindi and Marathi.
practice.title: Where I can help
practice.civil.d: Title and possession disputes, recovery suits, injunctions, tenancy matters and property documentation.
practice.criminal.d: Bail, complaints and trial work under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, the BNSS and the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023.
practice.family.d: Divorce, maintenance, custody and domestic violence matters, handled with discretion.
practice.consumer.d: Complaints before consumer commissions for defective goods, deficient services, unfair trade practices and medical negligence.
practice.corporate.d: Contracts, agreements, notices and compliance support for small businesses and startups.
practice.drafting.d: Sale deeds, leave and licence agreements, wills, affidavits, legal notices and powers of attorney.
enrol.title: Enrolled on the Roll of Advocates
enrol.p: Admitted as an advocate under Section 17 of the Advocates Act, 1961. You can verify my enrolment with the Bar Council of Maharashtra & Goa using the number below.
edu.title: Academic record
edu.ma.res: CGPI 7.04. Grade O in Economics of Human Development.
edu.hl4: Grade O in Economics of Human Development (M.A.)
contact.title: Write or call
contact.p: For a consultation, send a short note about your matter. I usually reply within one working day.
contact.hoursValue: Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 7 pm
footer.legal: This website is for information only and follows Rule 36 of the Bar Council of India Rules. It is not an advertisement or solicitation, and nothing here is legal advice.
